mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend shows a sustained decline (e.g., 3 consecutive monthly drops) but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong residential sales (RSAFS > 400,000) indicates an overheating economy with rising inflation expectations, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0% AND RSAFS > 400,000) occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime defined by housing starts exceeding 1000 thousand units, strong residential construction activity signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising year-over-year CPIAUCSL trend indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to earlier and more aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL shows a sustained upward trend (e.g., 3 consecutive monthly increases) but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market with strong economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and housing starts (HOUST > 900) indicates robust economic expansion across manufacturing and construction sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (INDPRO > 100 AND HOUST > 900) occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by unemployment below 4.0% and industrial production above 100, the economy is nearing its peak with high inflation risks, prompting Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle regime (UNRATE < 4.0% AND INDPRO > 100) occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
